rejectionPatterns.description: Internal-only legal-team discussion or forwarded internal question, with no case-relevant decision, answer, or external development
examples: Chris forwarded a question regarding Lawrence Terry's benefits/leave status to the internal LOA team; LOA Team acknowledged receipt.
Internal team gathered other-gig-platform work history for the nine drivers in the NYC mass arbitration (Guerrero et al.), responding to opposing counsel's information request.
Nat Flandreau said via Slack that the Bar Properties Litigation (Gardella) matter settled by "splitting the difference," citing a figure of $355.
Michelle Carlson followed up requesting Nat/Hillary run a Brightflag report of outside counsel firm names used since 2016, per Faegre Drinker's privilege-log request.

rejectionPatterns.description: Discovery-tracker/document housekeeping mechanics (empty folder setup, tracker comment replies, marking items resolved, document-access grants, historical firm/personnel-list requests) with no case-development substance or decision
examples: Outside counsel (BIPC) requested the Martin case file alongside Wynn's; Chris set up a Drive folder, currently empty pending documents from counsel.
Sarah Louardi marked as resolved a discovery-tracker action item in the Okamura, Jeri matter concerning all communications between the employee and any ER representative.
Shayda Nour was granted edit access to the Leverson v. BevMo! Check Request document, indicating settlement payment processing is underway.
Seth Taylor replied to a Discovery Tracker comment thread in the Wynn, Jessica matter.
Opposing counsel followed up asking where to find Gopuff's discovery-tracker link; Chris pointed to the tracker.

rejectionPatterns.description: Bare confirmation that a routine administrative step occurred (data-gathering complete, duplicate re-transmittal) with no other detail — narrower than agreement-execution events, which conflict with approved rows (see dropped patterns note)
examples: Jad Allen confirmed via Slack that the underlying data-gathering request for the Gallardo Texas Workforce Commission wage claim is complete.
Duplicate transmittal of the same Notice of Hearing in Raina Cotton v. Beverages And More, Inc., re-sent by the registered agent under a separate transmittal number.

approvalPatterns.description: Formal service of a new complaint, lawsuit, or hearing/proceeding notice — including from a registered agent, process server, or court clerk rather than Opposing Counsel directly — reliably approved as case-development substance
examples: Gopuff (GoBrands, Inc.) was served with a putative class action complaint (Case No. 2026CV032349, Denver County District Court, CO) on July 10.
Yopima, LLC filed suit against GoBrands, Inc.; served on registered agent CSC on 7/8/26, with an answer or appearance due within 21 days.
Beverages And More, Inc. was served with a Notice of Hearing in Raina Cotton v. Beverages And More, Inc. before the CA Labor Commissioner; answer/appearance due 8/11/26.

Opposing counsel (Laurel Employment Law) asked whether Gopuff is authorized to accept service of the complaint by notice and acknowledgment, or whether service should proceed through the registered agent.
